# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest released version of `cvrvaelger` on RubyGems.org.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public GitHub issue for security reports.

Report privately via GitHub Security Advisories:

1. Open https://github.com/bergholdt/cvrvaelger/security/advisories
2. Click **New draft security advisory**
3. Describe the issue, impact, and a minimal reproduction if possible

You can also email the maintainer listed in the gemspec. Please allow a reasonable time for a fix before any public disclosure.
